title: SpaceX's near $3 trillion rally comes with one big catch: Chart of the Day

title: Jabil raises annual profit forecast amid strong data center demand
title_zh: 数据中心需求强劲，捷普上调年度利润预期
summary: Jabil raised its 2026 profit forecast on Wednesday, as the electronic-component maker ‌looks to capitalize on AI-led demand for ‌data centers. A surge in data-center infrastructure spending, driven by strong ​demand for AI computing power, has benefited companies such as Jabil.
summary_zh: 捷普周三上调了 2026 年的利润预期，因为这家电子元件制造商希望利用人工智能主导的数据中心需求。在人工智能计算能力的强劲需求推动下，数据中心基础设施支出激增，使捷普等公司受益。

title: AI use in UK hits 'tipping point' as companies scale up, Google exec says
title_zh: 谷歌高管表示，随着公司规模扩大，英国人工智能的使用达到“临界点”
summary: Adoption of artificial intelligence has reached a "tipping point" in Britain, as companies move from experimentation ‌to large-scale deployment and start seeing returns, a Google Cloud executive ‌said on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 谷歌云高管周三表示，随着公司从实验转向大规模部署并开始看到回报，人工智能的采用在英国已经达到了“临界点”。
